title: CS daily tickler & QBR scratchpad
content:
Daily tickler (quick view) - Sophia
Date: 2026-03-14

Top of inbox / today things to do:
- 09:00 quick sync w/ Leo (15m) — finalize Acumen QBR narrative (who is speaking, goal = renewal + 15% ARR upsell).
- 10:30 Acumen prep call w/ customer (30m) — confirm metrics we’ll present.
- 11:00 unblock with Eng on PR#4567 (embedding dimension mismatch) — need ETA for patch so I can call out mitigation in QBR deck.
- 14:00 Bluewave renewal review — revenue ops asked for statement of usage+overages.
- End of day: inbox tidy + send follow-ups.

Notes to self (choppy):
- Acumen Health (account lead: Mira Chen)
  - Renewal: 2026-04-02 (30-day notice window).
  - Current plan: Hosted API, 3M tokens/mo. Past month usage down 28% — check if due to cost or model mismatch.
  - QBR asks: p50 latency (hosted), cost/token trend, recent failover incident (2026-02-27) summary + mitigation.
  - Upsell angle: Dedicated reserved capacity pilot for latency-sensitive workflow (estimate: -20% token cost at 95th pct).
  - Action items: pull cost/time series (ENG-ops dashboards), export 3-week KV cache hit rates, confirm security slide (private deploy options)
  - Slack threads: #cs-acumen (pin last month’s incident log)

- Bluewave Analytics (acct owner: Tariq Ansari)
  - Renewal/contract extension window: Q2 review call scheduled 2026-03-20.
  - They reported model hallucination on specific prompt templates (CS-2145).
  - Ticket CS-2145 assigned to Support Tier2 — need summary of root cause and workaround to include in renewal packet.
  - Action: ask Solutions Eng for rerank/rewrite checklist, gather sample prompts (anonymize PII).

- Fjord Retail (small pilot)
  - Quick follow-up: onboarding checklist incomplete: webhooks not firing for two routes.
  - Filed eng bug: RINF-1987 (webhook connector race).
  - Ask SRE for temporary patch for demo 2026-03-18.

QBR deck skeleton (What I want on slide speaker notes):
- 1) Executive summary: health, usage, ask (renewal/upsell).
- 2) What changed since last QBR: latency improvements, incident recap, cost delta.
- 3) KPIs: p50/p95 latency, tokens per session, cost/token, error rate, cache hit %.
- 4) Recent wins (features shipped) + upcoming roadmap items that help customer.
- 5) Risks & mitigation (capacity, fallback model, throttling policies).
- 6) Ask & next steps (POC offer, discounted reserved commit).

Prep checklist for each QBR:
- Pull last 90 days of metrics (p50/p95 latency, error rate, tokens/session) — source: console/per-route dashboard.
- Export support incidents since last QBR.
- Obtain usage forecast from Finance (for upsell calc).
- Confirm legal has latest SOW terms if we propose dedicated.
- Slide owner + speaker notes assigned.

Immediate follow-ups to send (TODAY):
- DM Mira: confirm who will be on Acumen QBR call. Mention dedicated pilot idea as a discussion point. (Slack template: short, say 2 options + ask for permission to present pricing).
- Ping @eng on PR#4567: any ETA? Need to present expected fix timeline on QBR. Include link to failing sample.
- Email RevOps for Bluewave usage statement export. Ask for last 6 months per-route cost breakdown.

Random scratch items / parking lot:
- Draft a short snippet for renewals playbook on handling latency regressions in QBR decks.
- Capture runbook reference: CONFLUENCE-RINF-8801 (QBR template) needs a checkbox for "show cache hit rate".
- Note: remember to anonymize prompt examples — customer privacy.

Personal reminders:
- Take lunch at 12:30 (really).
- Block 16:30-17:00 for tidy up and follow-up sends.

Things I need from teammates (short ask messages):
- Leo: can you run the 3-week KV cache export before 09:00? Upload csv to shared drive + tag in thread.
- Aisha (Solutions): sample prompt rewrites for Bluewave — 3 examples by EOD.
- Eng (Matt): ETA on PR#4567 and whether we can include temporary mitigation steps in the deck.

Tickets / refs to search later:
- CS-2145 (Bluewave hallucination)
- RINF-1987 (webhook connector race)
- PR#4567 (embeddings mismatch)
- CONFLUENCE-RINF-8801 (QBR template)

End-of-day outputs I want:
- Short one-page recap sent to Mira (Acumen) with 3 bullet asks.
- Raw metrics export uploaded to drive: users/sophia-ng/exports/acumen-2026-03-14.csv
- Follow-up email to Bluewave with sample prompt rewrites and next steps.

Notes to self about tone for QBR: concise, data-first, avoid engineering jargon, highlight reliability improvements and clear path for cost optimization.

-- scratchpad end --
